drivers: Three simple, independently verifiable rules (count +1 progression, shape and fill as distribution-of-three) that are familiar matrix rules
Rotation is tied to shape rather than a separate rule, which can confuse people who try to treat it as an independent attribute
Distractors systematically vary count, fill and rotation, so each rule must be fully resolved to eliminate options
Generous 105 s limit relative to the number of attributes to check
